translated_title: "We Won't Leave Mexico's Mountains of Guerrero," Governance Secretary Says
original_title: “No nos vamos a salir de la Montaña de Guerrero”, asegura Rosa Icela Rodríguez
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: After organized-crime violence displaced families in Guerrero's highlands, Governance Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez vowed a permanent security presence and a 13-point recovery plan.
